procedures.name: GetEmployeeDetails
procedures.definition: CREATE PROCEDURE GetEmployeeDetails @EmpID INT, @DeptID INT AS BEGIN SELECT EmpID, EmpName, Salary FROM Employees WHERE EmpID = @EmpID AND DeptID = @DeptID; END;
